title: noteloom document (simple format), version 1
description: The canonical interchange format: what `exportDocumentSimpleJSON` produces and `editor.toJSON()` returns by default, and what `useEditor({ doc })` / `importDocumentSimpleJSON` accept. Self-contained blocks in an array; `children` for nesting; each block's own fields under `data`. The internal engine shape (`{ rootId, blocks, runs }`) is a separate, unversioned implementation detail reachable via `editor.toJSON({ format: 'internal' })`.

version.description: Format version. Bumped only on a breaking change to this shape.

id.description: Stable identifier. Preserved across export and import.

type.description: Block type name, e.g. 'paragraph', 'heading', 'listItem', 'table', 'callout', a custom type.

data.description: The block's own fields, shape depending on `type`. Common: `text` (an HTML string carrying marks and atomic inline chips, round-tripped the same way clipboard copy/paste is), `level` (heading/toggleHeading), `ordered`/`checked`/`collapsed` (listItem), `language` (code), `href`/`color` (button), `kind`/`src`/`alt` (embed), `icon` (callout). `table` is flattened specially: `columns` (array of `{ id, label, type, width }`) + `rows` (a 2D array of HTML-string cells).

children.description: Nested child blocks. Present on container types (callout, layout, listItem/toggleHeading with nested content, …); absent on leaves.
